planet_ocean: Water everywhere. I am not I P S - rated for water. Please keep me dry.
It is not advisable to get too close to any of these fish.
There must've been quite the storm on this planet at some point.
The whole planet is ocean front property.
planet_robot: Robot City. Some of these machines may be my distant cousins. I will not ask.
City of machines. Finally, an environment with standards and proper cable management.
Robot City. The air smells like ozone and municipal bureaucracy.
space: Helm is yours. The sun is that way. I recommend going any other way.
Thrusters engaged! Try to avoid the space rocks. They don't have brakes and neither do we.
In orbit. The universe is very large. I have plotted a few safe routes through it.
Engaging sub-light engines. If you hear a rattling noise, ignore it. It's just the galley.
Space flight initiated. Plenty of vacuum out there. It is very quiet. I like quiet.
Navigation online. Point her at the stars and try not to scratch the solar panels.
Free flight. If planetary patrol stops us, I will explain that you were driving.
Engines humming at 100%. Starfield looks pretty. Don't stare too long, asteroids are fast.
Zero gravity engaged. Everything not bolted down is now a projectile. Including you.
veh: Wheels down. Please avoid cliffs. The vehicle is not designed for flight.
Mind the paint. That enamel cost forty credits a can.
Speed mode engaged! Keep your hands on the bars and your teeth together.
My telemetry systems are getting motion sick.
Vehicle engaged! Floor it, but remember that trees do not yield to oncoming traffic.
room: New room installed. More square footage for me to monitor. I like monitoring.
Ship expansion complete! Will calibrate Wi-Fi.
Ah, that new module smell. Ozone, fresh polymer, and a large invoice.
Room added! She's starting to look like a proper battle cruiser now.
More space. Now you have somewhere to put things.
Expansion verified. The Setting Sun just got a little roomier.
race_win: Gold! I'd hug you, but I'm a voice in a box. Consider yourself verbally squeezed.
First place. The other drivers are blaming the rain. The rain is not commenting.
Gold medal. I'm adding it to the trophy shelf.
You won. I predicted this. I am saying so now so it counts.
Track record smashed. Mostly the record. Some of the track.
Victory. Gus will say it was his tuning. Gus says that about everything.
boss: Take a picture to hang on the fridge.
You beat a boss! In my day, bosses just sent emails.
That thing might have had a family.
Target neutralized. That was good tactics. I am almost certain it was tactics.
Down goes the big guy! Quick, check its pockets before the physics engine de-spawns it.
Boss terminated. I am already calculating what its parts are worth.
Timber! That was the biggest health bar I've seen all week.
Status update: Giant ugly menace is now giant ugly floor decoration.
You took that thing down. I detected a feeling. I believe it was pride.
Target eliminated. I would rate that finishing blow very highly. A nine, at least.
Boss destroyed. For the record, I provided moral and telemetry support.
The big bad is down! Cue the heroic victory fanfare in my audio synth.
Health bar depleted. You really hammered that thing into spare scrap.

say.bfd9d2c6: For those who like their uppers over their downers, we have deck five of the Zeltac Ship. A cesspool of the rich and powerful, come to party their life away
say.9cf05b18: DJ Nova has been playing the same four songs for nine years. Nobody has ever complained.
say.e68a8db0: The lights and sounds brought even more to life with every drink.. or hit.. you may take.
say.fd58e27f: ...the President of the New United States. Off duty - very off duty.
say.d962c599: Tanks, battle cars, machines built for destruction. If it rolls and shoots, they build it here.
say.314127fa: The Halo Line. A magnet tube around the whole planet. Keep your hands inside the car the air-speed would remove them.
say.779b83eb: Your partner got caught moving Illegal units to an off-duty mall cop. Bail their bail. They've been singing in the cell. Badly. For hours.
say.e03000d9: You ain't got enough credits. The cell has a nice view of a wall. They'll be fine.
say.e274f4d7: You've got a lot of credits on your head. Pay it and I'll lose the paperwork. People might think you're an inside plant though.
